name: Mortal Remains
english_description: A classic English-language LPMud, admin'd by "Cyanide" from 1997 to 2000, running the public-domain-released TMI-2 ("The Mud Institute") 1.4alpha mudlib base. A ~13,500-file archive of real 1997-2000 wizard-home content across dozens of authors (Cyanide, Chronos, Nightmask, Spooner, and many more). New characters pass through a full TMI-2 registration (password, email, real name) and a menu-driven race/gender/handedness/alignment stat-reroll wizard before landing in Decatur, the starting town. A newbie helper NPC, Alucard, stationed at the Intersection east of the town center, points new players toward starter equipment and directs them to any of five class halls scattered around town: a Pit Fighter's guild and a Sharpshooter's guild for warriors (joining awards a class-marker item, "A Pit Fighter's Scars"), a mage hall, a rogue hall, and the Temple of Talos for priests. The preloaded channel daemon makes a real outbound socket-connect attempt on every boot to a real (now long-dead) 1999-era Intermud-3 router address, reflecting the mud's original era of live inter-mud connectivity.
